originalTitle: US stocks today: S&P 500 and Nasdaq open lower as Iran tensions jolt sentiment, chip stocks slide
simplifiedContent: The US stock market started the week on a low note due to rising tensions between the US and Iran. This has caused oil prices to go up, which is making investors a bit nervous. As a result, two important groups of stocks, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, are down, with technology companies that make computer chips being particularly affected. The Dow, another group of stocks, is doing slightly better, but overall, investors are being cautious. This matters because it can impact the overall mood of the market and potentially affect your investments.

originalTitle: Mylan to sell up to $363 million stake in India's Biocon, term sheet shows
simplifiedContent: Mylan Inc, a company, is planning to sell some of its shares in an Indian company called Biocon Ltd. The shares they plan to sell are worth up to $363 million. This means Mylan owns a significant amount of Biocon and is now looking to sell a portion of it. The sale involves up to 92 million shares, which is a large number. This news matters because it shows that Mylan is looking to reduce its stake in Biocon, which could affect the value of both companies.

originalTitle: Quote of the day by Irving Fisher: "The chief evils of speculation flow from the participation of the general public, who lack the special knowledge, and enter the market in a purely gambling spirit"
simplifiedContent: A well-known expert, Irving Fisher, once said that regular people who invest in the stock market without knowing what they're doing can cause problems. This is because they often make decisions based on emotions and trends, rather than careful thought. Fisher's warning is still relevant today, as many people use online trading platforms to invest without fully understanding what they're doing. It's important for investors to make informed decisions and not try to make quick profits, as this can lead to losses. By being careful and disciplined, investors are more likely to succeed in the long run.

originalTitle: HCL Tech Q1 Results: Board declares interim dividend of  ₹12 per share. Details here
simplifiedContent: HCL Technologies, a company listed on the stock market, has announced that it will pay its shareholders a dividend of ₹12 for each share they own. This means that if you own shares of HCL Technologies, you will receive this amount of money as a reward for investing in the company. The company has been paying dividends consistently for a long time, which is a good sign for investors. The company will finalize the list of shareholders who are eligible for this payout on July 17, and will make the payment on July 27. This news matters because it shows that the company is sharing its profits with its shareholders, which can be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: HCL Tech Q1 results: Profit jumps 20% YoY to  ₹4,626 crore; dividend declared; key takeaways from June quarter earnings
simplifiedContent: HCL Tech, a technology company, just released its quarterly earnings report, which shows that its profit increased by 20% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹4,626 crore. This means the company made more money this quarter than it did a year ago. The profit also went up by 3% from the previous quarter. The company has also declared a dividend, which is a portion of the profit that will be shared with its shareholders. This update is important because it gives investors an idea of how well the company is doing and whether its performance is improving over time.

originalTitle: SK Hynix shares plunge 15% to one-month low after blockbuster Nasdaq debut
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix's stock price dropped by 15% on July 13th, which is the biggest decline it has ever had. This happened after the company had a very successful debut on the Nasdaq stock market. The drop in SK Hynix's stock price also affected the overall South Korean stock market, causing it to fall by 9%. This big change in the stock price is making people wonder if the company's value is truly reflected in its stock price and if it can keep making money in the future. The decline is largely due to investors selling their shares to take profits after the successful debut.
